title: Bug 624364: Intrastat DE groups detail lines by Country/Region of Origin
summary: German Intrastat export now groups detail lines by both Tariff Number and Country of Origin to prevent merging lines with the same tariff but different origins and losing origin information.
key_points: Added Country/Region of Origin Code (Field ID 24) to detail grouping sets in INTRA-2022-DE data-exchange definition
Updated both receipt (7-RCPTDETAIL) and shipment (8-SHPTDETAIL) grouping configurations
Implemented upgrade logic to re-import the corrected definition for existing tenants
Added test coverage for the data-exchange definition
